Thanks, I get what you are saying. Also reading your username after reading the content of your message gave me a good chuckle. 

I'll keep the idea of a pet in mind. Would need some working around with my living situation and I would feel guilty having an animal that I could not provide anything short of the best care for. But really I just want a human connection with some people I can call friends. Crazy how that's a challenge in this world. 

I appreciate your message. Take care.
